359:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...That's the situation. The EVAs that transferred here, and their pilots, have agreed to cooperate with $c.」

359:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Now then, everyone, introduce yourselves once more.」

359:t_1:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm $$渚カヲル$$. Together with $$シンジ$$, I pilot EVA Unit-13.」

359:t_1:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「$$アヤナミレイ$$...」

359:t_1:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$. I'll be in your care for a little while.」

359:t_1:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'm $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$! To the faces I know and the ones I don't, nice to meet you.」

359:t_1:11.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong, $$シンジ$$?! You're looking down!」

359:t_1:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't get nervous now. It's only been three months since then, you know.」

359:t_1:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
(We decided not to tell the people of $c that fourteen years have passed in our world since then...)

359:t_1:14.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I'm no different from everyone else... Even if I'm told that when I woke up, fourteen years had gone by, I can't accept it...)

359:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「From this $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ as our base, we will begin a counteroffensive against the Empire and the organizations cooperating with it.」

359:t_1:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But won't the Empire send troops after us right away...?」

359:t_1:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「There's no need to worry. From now on, $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ will keep changing position, and we'll set the jamming to its maximum level.」

359:t_1:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If our location gets pinpointed even under that level of alert, then it can only be an informant.」

359:t_1:19.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「It's reassuring to have a base this substantial.」

359:t_1:20.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Yeah... This is truly the first step of the counteroffensive.」

359:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And our first strategic objective is to liberate $$翠の地球$$ from the $$サイデリアル$$.」

359:t_1:23.en:
$$シャア$$
「With the Empire's control now near 85%, descending to $$蒼の地球$$ requires proper preparation.」

359:t_1:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「Also, if the battle reaches a stalemate once we join in, the $$サイデリアル$$ left on $$翠の地球$$ showing up as reinforcements is something we must avoid at all costs.」

359:t_1:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「And above all, we have almost no information about the $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy.」

359:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By retaking $$翠の地球$$, where their forces are comparatively few, we gather information on the $$サイデリアル$$...?」

359:t_1:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if we don't get as far as retaking it, there's a benefit if we can make them split their forces on $$蒼の地球$$ off to $$翠の地球$$ to deal with us.」

359:t_1:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「That is the purpose of this operation. ...Do you understand, $$カミーユ$$?」

359:t_1:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「And we also need to find out the true nature of the fundamental calamity we saw in that mysterious universe.」

359:t_1:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no doubt it's connected to the $$サイデリアル$$. If we gather information on them, that will become clear as well.」

359:t_1:33.en:
$$フォウ$$
(Colonel $$シャア$$ has never stepped up to the front at a briefing before, has he?)

359:t_1:34.en:
$$ファ$$
(Now that you mention it, you're right. Until now he seemed more like an observer than a commander.)

359:t_1:35.en:
$$カツ$$
(What's wrong with that? He suits that kind of role, after all.)

359:t_1:36.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(If $$カツ$$ approves, nobody in $c is going to complain.)

359:t_1:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You there...! No private chatter!」

359:t_1:39.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That concludes the briefing. As soon as the staff to guard $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ are in position, we will head for $$翠の地球$$.」

359:t_1:40.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Until then, everyone prepare for the unexpected. Dismissed...!」

359:t_1:41.en:
$$シンジ$$
(...Everyone is still fighting with a goal, even now...)

359:t_1:42.en:
$$赤木$$
「Good thing, $$シンジ$$. That the $$クォーター$$ still had spare clothes for you.」

359:t_1:44.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's with you...? It's a reunion at last, so you could hug me and bawl your eyes out, you know.」

359:t_1:47.en:
$$青山$$
(It seems $$赤木$$ is also unsure how to act around $$シンジ$$ right now.)

359:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still, when the $$時空震動$$ hit, I'd resigned myself to a parting forever, and yet we meet again after three months.」

359:t_1:49.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are $$ミサト$$ and the others doing okay? What about $$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$?」

359:t_1:51.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Things in our world are still pretty confused, you see. There's a lot we still don't understand.」

359:t_1:52.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then, are $$ミサト$$ and the others missing?」

359:t_1:53.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$シンジ$$ believes they'll see them again, though.」

359:t_1:54.en:
$n
「That's right. After all, we managed to meet again like this, too.」

359:t_1:56.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Is that EVA, Unit-13 or whatever, a two-seater?」

359:t_1:57.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The Double Entry System... A vessel that carries both our souls, mine and $$シンジ$$'s.」

359:t_1:60.en:
$n
(Maybe it's because it was at the center of that phenomenon that should be called $$サードインパクト$$...)

359:t_1:61.en:
$$甲児$$
(The EVAs we knew went only up to Unit-03, and now suddenly there's 08, 09 and 13. $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ sure worked hard.)

359:t_1:62.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$シンジ$$'s father is the one leading $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, after all. He'd go that far.」

359:t_1:63.en:
$n
「You heard that...? I thought I was speaking quietly...」

359:t_1:64.en:
$$カヲル$$
「No... It's just that you're the type whose feelings show on your face.」

359:t_1:66.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is this the time to be glad you've stopped being the quiet type?!」

359:t_1:68.en:
$$ユノハ$$
(H-He has a rather unique atmosphere, doesn't he?)

359:t_1:69.en:
$$サザンカ$$
(So he and $$シンジ$$ really are in that kind of relationship, huh...)

359:t_1:70.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
(Stop it, $$サザンカ$$...! That kid might be listening!)

359:t_1:71.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Then it makes no difference if we talk about it openly.」

359:t_1:74.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hey, $$シンジ$$... $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are here, too. Want to hear them sing live?」

359:t_1:75.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is here, too. Want them to play something to pump you up?」

359:t_1:76.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Sorry. I'm tired, so I'm going to rest a little.」

359:t_1:77.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Y-Yeah... Right. It's right after the transfer, after all...」

359:t_1:78.en:
$$赤木$$
「Get a good rest, $$シンジ$$. Things look like they're about to get rough again.」

359:t_1:80.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'll keep $$シンジ$$ company. Well then...」

359:t_1:81.en:
$$甲児$$
「That $$シンジ$$... Something's definitely off with him...」

359:t_1:82.en:
$$さやか$$
「Yeah... He's back to being as jumpy as when we first met.」

kept_omissions: 359:t_1:13: 話さない事にした - who decided is unstated; rendered 'We decided' (Shinji's group of EVA pilots).
359:t_1:72: Malloy's そういう意味じゃない - whose meaning is unstated; rendered neutrally as 'That's not the point'.
359:t_1:69: Sazanka's そういう関係 - the pair (Kaworu, Shinji) supplied from the scene; the nature of the relationship kept vague as in Japanese.
359:t_1:53: Kaworu's シンジ君は... - the referents (Misato and the others) are supplied as 'they'.
uncertain: 359:t_1:7: Rei's self-introduction uses the speaker token $$アヤナミレイ$$ (Rei (Tentative Name)) because the glossary gives that Japanese exactly; in speech it reads 'Rei (Tentative Name)...'.
359:t_1:13/14: 僕達 / みんなと同じ - 'We decided' assumed to mean the EVA group; 14 is read as Shinji being in the same boat as everyone (time-lost) - meaning of 'でも、僕もみんなと同じなのに' is elliptical.
359:t_1:6/8/9/10: full-name tokens used for self-introductions (渚カヲル, 式波・アスカ・ラングレー, 真希波・マリ・イラストリアス, 碇シンジ) - names appear as Given Family in English.
359:t_1:57: Double Entry System not in glossary; left as plain English.
359:t_1:64/68: gender-neutral 'you' for $n; Yunoha's 子 = Kaworu, rendered 'He'.
